2301-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-2930-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-950-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-6458--203.easyPrerequisites:
You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1957-2530-6458--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity ability, gaining 1 life and causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

77-5145-5466-8095.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2842-4247-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

880-3470-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

969-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

851-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
851-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1806-2060-2445-5256-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-6965-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1169-1563-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

5086-5183-5231-6291-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6291-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

2341-2495-2593.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-6798-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

104-360-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-360-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2478-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

486-1978-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
486-1978-3291.description:
Cause Karametra's Acolyte to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat from step 2.

3220-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-4853-5686.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1844-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
Your deck size is at least 2.
1844-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

539-3717-4657.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

141-5147-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-5147-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4089-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4089-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore has a power of at least 2.
3719-4089-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1506-2178-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1506-2178-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1806-2034-4452-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
"Sliver" chosen with Rukarumel.
1806-2034-4452-5072.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eternal Scourge's encore ability by paying {3} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Eternal Scourge tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets infinite Eternal Scourge tokens with haste and colorless mana.

4690-5003-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four basic lands.
4690-5003-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Phylath, adding {R}.
Phylath dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Phylath enters the battlefield, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Plants, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1612.description:
Cast Shard of the Nightbringer by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Shard of the Nightbringer triggers, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Vito triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1371-2716-3948-4398.description:
Cast Enduring Ideal.
Enduring Ideal is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Enduring Ideal with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Enduring Ideal.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Enduring Ideal's Epic ability, and they can not use Enduring Ideal due to Stranglehold.
